newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank says banks can't avoid consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank says banks can't avoid consolidation.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Wednesday that Germany's banks would not be able to avoid a trend towards consolidation and that it would play an important role in that process.

"The German banks cannot escape the process of concentration and Vereinsbank faces playing an important role in this," chief executive Albrecht Schmidt said in the text of a speech to be delivered to the bank's annual shareholder meeting.

Schmidt said the sharp rise in Vereinsbank's share price in recent months was explained by the bank's earnings position and by "assumptions about possible structural changes in the German banking market" after Deutsche Bank AG said last July it had amassed a 5.21 percent stake in in Vereinsbank.
Deutsche's announcement prompted speculation that Germany's overcrowded banking sector faces a wave of mergers and takeovers.
Deutsche said at the time that it had no immediate plans to increase its stake in Vereinsbank and that the purchase was aimed at deterring potential bidders for the bank.
